# cato_pop_bgp_profile (Resource)

Manages one account-scoped PoP BGP community profile. This resource does not attach the profile to a BGP session. Import using its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Creates a profile without attaching it to a BGP session.
resource "cato_pop_bgp_profile" "example" {
  name = "Private communities"
  # description = "Terraform managed BGP communities"
  communities = [
    { from = "65001", to = "100" },
    { from = "65001", to = "200" },
  ]
}

# Community pairs are unordered. Each value is a canonical decimal string, 0..65535.
# The API restricts community changes while the profile is attached to a subnet/session.
# terraform import cato_pop_bgp_profile.example 12345
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `communities` (Attributes Set) Unordered community pairs. Values are canonical decimal strings from 0 through 65535. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--communities))
- `name` (String) Name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Removing the value clears it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID
